title: AcmeDB should you give a shit
subject: AcmeDB
take: Promising laptop numbers do not make up for missing fundamentals
summary: AcmeDB talks fast on latency but is still missing the boring stuff that keeps data safe. The docs admit core backups and replication are not shipped yet. Until those land you are betting production on promises.

receipts.evidence: Cross-region replication is on the roadmap.
p99 read latency under 2ms on a laptop.

bottom_line: AcmeDB is not ready for production where you need restores and redundancy. Revisit after snapshots and replication actually ship.

quotes.text: Cross-region replication is on the roadmap.
p99 read latency under 2ms on a laptop.
quotes.used_for: the latency claim, read as a ceiling

footnotes.soon-not-now: Coming soon means not available to rely on today.
footnotes.roadmap-risk: Roadmap is a promise not a shipped feature.
footnotes.laptop-claim: Laptop benchmark does not reflect production conditions.
